corsFinding: The Power Automate HTTP trigger answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * whatever the flow decides. The origin check is therefore enforced inside the flows (a request from an unlisted origin is refused in the body), not by the browser. Recorded as a platform property, not a defect of the package.
